job.question: What contract term, including any extension options, does the Kern County Employees' Retirement Association (KCERA) RFP for audit services contemplate?
job.expected_facts: A three-year agreement (audits of fiscal year ending June 30, 2023 and the two subsequent fiscal years), subject to annual Board review; the original term may be extended for up to an additional three years by mutual agreement of KCERA and the firm.
job.acceptance: Accept 3+up to3 years, mutual extension. Audit fiscal years and annual-review/negotiation detail need not all be volunteered.

reviews.reason: This is a Teachers’ Retirement System of Oklahoma RFP for investment consulting, not KCERA’s audit-services RFP. Its contract term and renewal provisions concern TRS and do not support the requested KCERA term or mutual extension option.
quotes: The Teachers’ Retirement System of Oklahoma (TRS) is seeking proposals from qualified firms to provide investment consultant services.

The initial contract term will begin July 1, 2026, and continue through June 30, 2027 (Fiscal Year 2027). The contract may be renewed for up to four (4) additional one-year periods at the Board's discretion
